descriptionChirho: Evoking astonishment and wonder, describing something extraordinary or beyond normal expectation, often used of God's works and deeds. All three clusters are purely inflectional variants (feminine singular, neuter singular, neuter plural) with identical semantic content: 'marvelous/amazing/wonderful' (eng), 'maravillosa/asombroso' (spa), 'ya ajabu/ajabu' (swa: wondrous), 'adbhut/aashcharya' (hin: wonderful/astonishment), 'ajiib' (arb: wondrous), 'nollaun' (kor: astonishing). The English variation between 'marvelous', 'amazing', and 'wonderful' reflects translator stylistic choice, not distinct lexical senses.
